title: Read Overview artifacts from the source page tree
outcome: Overview artifact links come from the loader's own page tree rather than from the breadcrumb tree, so the flattening that follows can rebuild breadcrumbs without putting artifact links at risk.
acceptanceCriteria: changeArtifacts is called with source.pageTree; the comment explaining why it needed the breadcrumb tree is removed, since the meta-collection fix removed the page shadowing it compensated for.
All ten Change Overviews render the same artifact titles, order, and hrefs as before this slice, verified against the built output rather than by inspection.
withDirectChangePages is assessed: if nothing reaches it any more it is deleted together with its tests, and if something still does, the reason is recorded in the Review page.
No link in the built site is dead, checked by resolving every /changes/ href in the prerendered HTML against the generated pages.
